scripts.build: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'), fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('frontend')) { execSync('npm --prefix frontend run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); try { fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'public', {recursive:true}); } catch(e){} } else { execSync('npx vite build', {stdio:'inherit'}); try { fs.mkdirSync('frontend', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('dist', 'frontend/dist', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('dist', 'public', {recursive:true}); } catch(e){} }"
